summary: Small status card with a text face that changes between three moods, based on the momentum score and the streak.
purpose: Gives the user a quick, friendly read on how their momentum is doing.
why: Likely reason: a playful way to show progress. The code does not state this directly.
how: Reads the momentum score and streak days from the profile. Picks one of three moods: thriving when the score is at least 70 and the streak at least 3; needs attention when the score is below 40; otherwise neutral. Builds the colours, text face, title, message, and icon for that mood, then draws the card.
inputs: Momentum score and streak days from the profile in the store.
outputs: A card showing the mood title, text face, message, and badge label, styled for that mood.
risks: The thresholds 70, 40, and 3 are fixed in the code, so changing the scoring rules means editing this file. The message shows the raw score, so an out-of-range score would show as is.
debug: If the wrong mood shows, compare the score and streak in the profile with the thresholds. If the message text looks wrong, check the momentum score value.
